name: kitchen-detail-verify
description: KITCHEN-DETAIL: the kitchen counter's backsplash is real glazed ceramic tile (procedural subway painter, one texture period per 0.6 m of run → 150 × 75 mm running-bond tile with ~3 mm grout) and the sink carries a single-lever mixer (escutcheon, Ø26 mm riser, swan-neck TubeGeometry spout, aerator ring, side lever) plus a Ø90 mm basket strainer. Walk poses at Realistic, 13:00, lights on: down the run from the west, square on the backsplash, close on the sink (yaw −0.785 aims at the sink, which sits at world x≈8.225 z≈7.325 — the brief's yaw 0.3 faced away from it), a grazing look along the run for grout/gloss, then the same first pose at 20:00 for the lamp highlight on the glaze; then the kitchen room editor. Probes the counter's backsplash material (map/normalMap present, texture repeat) and the tap mesh count. Run with SHOT_GPU=1. Pair with the same scenario at SHOT_URL='http://localhost:5200/?ff=kitchenDetail:off' for the before frames.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: probe-backsplash
steps.eval: (() => { let tube = 0; let best = null; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const g = o.geometry; if (g && g.type === 'TubeGeometry') tube++; if (!g || g.type !== 'BoxGeometry' || !g.parameters) return; const p = g.parameters; if (Math.abs(p.height - 0.48) > 1e-6 || Math.abs(p.depth - 0.015) > 1e-6) return; const m = o.material; best = { width: +p.width.toFixed(3), map: !!m.map, normalMap: !!m.normalMap, roughnessMap: !!m.roughnessMap, colour: m.color.getHexString(), roughness: m.roughness, repeat: m.map ? [+m.map.repeat.x.toFixed(3), +m.map.repeat.y.toFixed(3)] : null } }); console.log('[probe] kitchen-detail', JSON.stringify({ flag: window.__store.getState().featureFlags.kitchenDetail, backsplash: best, spoutTubes: tube })) })()

steps.name: pose-kitchen-east
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(6.8, 8.0); l.setYaw(-1.5708); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: pose-backsplash
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(7.5, 8.35); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: pose-sink-close
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(7.3, 8.25); l.setYaw(-0.785); l.setPitch(-0.35) })()

steps.name: pose-backsplash-graze
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(6.6, 8.3); l.setYaw(-0.9); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: pose-kitchen-night
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(6.8, 8.0); l.setYaw(-1.5708); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()
